name: Jangubai
notes: Early Age of Machinery, around or shortly after Year 2,200. Jangubai organizes apprentices and workers against debt bondage. Her movement presses industrial authorities for independent lodging, enforceable contracts and relief after injury. The University register proposes a connection to Formation of the Furnace Confederacy, Dispute over Patent Claims on Charcoal Measures and Plateau Charter Crisis. The capacity and timing depend on the event testimony.
sources: Author’s revised Early Age of Machinery placement and political roles, 2026-11-24.
